launches.tagline: We connect specialty food stores with their next best selling products
launches.body:
**TLDR:** [**Airgoods**](https://airgoods.com/) is a wholesale marketplace that makes it easy for specialty food stores to buy their inventory in one place. Today, we focus on connecting these stores with over 1,000 non-alcoholic and functional beverage products.

Hi everyone! We’re Aaron, Elian and Paolo – the team behind Airgoods. We’re on a mission to level the playing field for specialty food stores by offering tools previously only available to big box chains.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73226&key=user_uploads/797737/38498184-4bb5-425f-8025-35e02960e710)

### 🤔 **The Problem**

* **Specialty food stores struggle to stay up to date on new and trending products.** Today, most rely on social media platforms like Instagram for discovery. Once they see a product they like, they send the brand a DM to ask for a sample – which can take weeks to months to receive.
* **To purchase inventory, they have to manage dozens of direct brand relationships.** That means placing orders and coordinating payments over email, phone calls and texts.
* **Best sellers often go out of stock.** At most specialty stores, reorders only happens when the buyer sees that the shelf is empty. This means there are days – if not weeks – that go by with best sellers being out of stock.
* **Most brands don’t have the resources to run an in-house wholesale team.** They primarily rely on inbounds, and many relationships end because of limited resources to maintain the account over email, Instagram DMs, and texts.

### **🧰 Our Solution**

Airgoods makes it easy for specialty food stores to discover, sample and order inventory in one place. How?

* **Curated marketplace views that align with store type.** This industry is unique in that the product mix is homogenous within the same store type. For example: an specialty cheese shop in New York offers the same kind of products as one in San Francisco. This allows us to show a business all of the products they want – and nothing they don’t – with high accuracy. For example, today liquor stores and NA bottle shops see the following.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73226&key=user_uploads/797737/653e9c5f-f193-4070-9c93-b6da89fddb52)

* **Simplified sample requests.** On Airgoods, stores receive samples in days instead of weeks. We do this by making it easy for brands to track and fulfill samples with in-platform tools that embed the process into their daily order fulfillment workflows. By streamlining this process, we also help brands boost sample to order conversion rates.
* **Data-driven recommendations and insights.** We provide our buyers with insight into what products are selling best in similar stores around the country. This adds transparency for an industry that traditionally relies on word-of-mouth recommendations.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73226&key=user_uploads/797737/015ce154-6e52-4ac5-b3ce-058e77460b29)

We also integrate with Shopify, which allows brands to fulfill orders from Airgoods without having to onboard to a new sales channel.

### **🐶 Who are we?**

We are three Yale alums who have been close friends since our first year of college. Before starting Airgoods, Aaron and Elian worked together at an emerging VC fund in NYC, and Paolo and Elian were on Yale’s mens soccer team.

Aaron’s dad owns a brick and mortar shop in Maine, and he saw how challenges around ordering inventory put his small store at a major disadvantage to big box chains with dedicated buying teams.

### **🙂 Our Ask**

* Do you have any favorite non-alcoholic or functional beverage brands? Let us know! We’d love to onboard them [**🥂**](https://emojipedia.org/clinking-glasses/)
* Connect us to anyone you may know in the specialty grocery / wholesale space (store owners, brand owners, service providers) – we’d love to chat at [**founders@airgoods.com**](mailto:founders@airgoods.com)

Hey there! I’m Brian from [DataShare](https://datashare.co/).

DataShare is a data-as-a-service platform that lets you embed charts, dashboards and exports directly into your product. For example, if you run an accounting startup, DataShare would enable you to embed a full profit and loss dashboard, with downloadable statements. It’s backed by an enterprise-grade data warehouse and can be implemented in fewer than 20 lines of code.

[Book some time](https://calendly.com/bb-datashare/datashare-intro-call) if you want to learn more. We can walk through all DataShare has to offer and give you an idea of what an integration would look like for your tech stack.
[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LNZGCl7lQMU)
# Background

Over the past few years, SaaS and financial services companies have been pushed by their customers to provide better business intelligence tooling. These systems are complex to design, hard to build, expensive to run, and challenging to scale. I've seen numerous examples of companies doing things like operating a database per customer or running 10+ hour-long pre-computation jobs just to deliver customer-facing data products.

However, during my time at Stripe, I saw a different model. I ran the engineering team that built [Data Pipeline](https://stripe.com/data-pipeline) and [Sigma](https://stripe.com/sigma), and due to Stripe's infrastructure, we were able to rapidly deliver new products that helped to retain some of Stripe’s largest customers.

DataShare is packaging up what I learned, and delivering that knowledge to the rest of the market.

# The Product

DataShare is a platform that combines a scalable, enterprise-grade data warehouse with a front-end framework for integrating business intelligence tools directly into your product.

Charts and dashboards can be built with a point-and-click UI and can be integrated with just two lines of code.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74483&key=user_uploads/8960/57e3c582-7c6a-4595-9e20-efb8550438c5)

You can also skip the UI if you want. Visualizations can be built using DataShare’s AI-powered assistant.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74483&key=user_uploads/8960/3520b630-6afd-4725-9e9f-9bad448c8ee4)

DataShare supports more than 20 types of data sources, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB, and is backed by a full data warehouse.

# About DataShare

[Brian](https://www.linkedin.com/company/withdatashare/) - I spent the past 4 years at Stripe and the past year and a half as the eng manager for [Data Pipeline](https://stripe.com/data-pipeline) and [Sigma](https://stripe.com/sigma). My team and I supported some of Stripe’s largest customers like DoorDash, Slack, Zoom, and Lime, helping keep them happy and run crucial financial workflows.

# Ask

If you are thinking about building our customer-facing business intelligence tools, or you have a customer-facing BI stack you don’t like, reach out at [hello@datashare.co](mailto:hello@datashare.co) or grab [time to chat](https://calendly.com/bb-datashare/datashare-intro-call).

Thanks!

Brian from DataShare

launches.body:
## **⏳ TL;DR:**

Revamp helps eCommerce brands and agencies understand customer behavior by creating smarter segments for targeted email and paid acquisition campaigns.

**😣 What’s the problem?**

Email marketers and paid media buyers struggle to understand customer behavior because:

* eCommerce data is fragmented across many platforms
* Most brands and agencies are non-technical and struggle to stitch data together
* Even if they stitch the data, analyzing it and acting on it is a struggle

As a result, email marketers default to generic customer segments and media buyers resort to using the bare minimum in their acquisition campaigns.

This translates to millions of unpersonalized emails sent every day and millions of dollars in wasted ad spend on mediocre customer segments.

**👕 Why are we solving this?**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73292&key=user_uploads/1323620/c904f41c-40ee-4988-aa9c-271a0d7b0a77)

We’re [Amin Akhtar](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amin-akhtar-15048/) and [Stephen Campbell.](https://www.linkedin.com/in/stephenwcampbell/) We’ve been friends for years and will be co-founders for many more to come!\
\
Let me (Amin) tell you the story of how we got here 🙂 \
\
As Chief Revenue Officer of a bootstrapped D2C brand, I found myself spending time I didn’t have wrangling customer data across an ever-expanding tech stack.\
\
As a result, I, like most D2C marketers, resorted to using basic customer segments like “purchased in the last 30 days” in campaigns – that too without really knowing anything about their behavior besides the obvious. \
\
The outcome? Declining revenue from over email and dropping conversion across paid acquisition campaigns that kept me up at night.\
\
To solve my problem I built a prototype (read: series of massive spreadsheets) to create better segments which drove a near-instant 5% increase in revenue from email campaigns + improved performance on the acquisition side.\
\
After hearing my pain points for (at least) the hundredth time, Stephen decided to partner up with me and we got to building. Now we’re actively realizing our vision of a better future for eCommerce retention.

**🔎 How are we solving it?**

Revamp intelligently stitches data across Klaviyo and Shopify, automatically creates valuable customer segments and calculates metrics and insights specific to that segment. \
\
We then give users the ability to flexibly analyze data and observe differences in behavior in seconds - a task that would’ve taken them days if not weeks to do without it!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73292&key=user_uploads/1323620/2eebc8ac-5659-44cd-9ead-cad50cb0fa8b)

Finally, users can push our segments to Klaviyo with one click and Revamp does the heavy lifting of making sure everything’s synced up!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73292&key=user_uploads/1323620/a13b0278-c93c-4f6d-bc91-3e90cb23da5c)

**🙏 How can you help us?**

* Drop us a follow on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/revamp-ai/) and follow our journey!
* We’d greatly appreciate any intros to D2C brands, eCommerce agencies or anyone looking to improve their email marketing!

If you know anyone in the space feel free to reach out at [founders@getrevamp.ai](mailto:founders@getrevamp.ai)

Hey everyone, we’re [Asad](https://www.linkedin.com/in/asadsdar/) and [Daniel](https://linkedin.com/in/daniel-ruiz-a73818aa) from [Synch](https://www.withsynch.com/)!\
[ ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PiHGtnI5qps)

# What is Synch?

Synch is a unified sales platform for both your Sales and Sales Ops teams. We work out of the box with Salesforce with no implementation time required.

# **The World Today**

Revenue tech is incredibly fragmented. Almost everyone uses Salesforce, but they don’t build auxiliary products well. This has led to a long tail of point-solution companies that only handle tiny portions of the sales team’s workflows. You buy one product for forecasting, one for pipeline management, another for lead routing, etc.

Additionally, even though all these point solutions pull customer data from a common spot (Salesforce), none of them "talk to each other."

We are building a company that gives you each of those SKUs while also giving you the tools to manage your SFDC environment. We want you to spend less time worrying about your tools and systems and more time worrying about your leads and prospects.

In our previous roles, it became increasingly clear that more time was spent on non-revenue generating activities than selling. Sales leadership spends an inordinate amount of time managing their tech stack, evaluating new vendors, and training their team on using tools - all at the expense of closing deals. 

# **Our Solution**

**For your Sales team**, we offer many different SKUs with a shared analytics suite so leaders can spend less time evaluating multiple vendors. Today, we offer forecasting, deal review, pipeline management, alerts, lead assignment, and other features that require zero implementation time. We share data between these products so information from our dashboarding tool (AE demo conversion rates) can automatically adjust your round-robin setup in your lead routing tool — "Turn my round robin into a 55-45 in favor of Tommy because he has a better close rate over the last two weeks", as an example.

**On the SalesOps side**, we provide you with tools to manage and maintain your SFDC instance. You can turn plain-text inputs into built-out Apex Code or flows, get robust dashboards with only a few clicks, and manage your Salesforce schema without ever needing to go into Salesforce.

**All of this works out of the box with SFDC. Just SSO & Go.**

**Ask**

[Feel free to grab time directly on my calendar here](https://calendly.com/danielsynch) if you want to learn more, or check out our blog post: [https://www.withsynch.com/blog/announcing-synch.](https://www.withsynch.com/blog/announcing-synch)

Hey everyone! We’re Asad Dar and Daniel Ruiz from [Magik](https://www.usemagik.com/)!

Magik automates Salesforce workflows and data reports using AI, allowing you to get insights from and build your CRM in a fraction of the time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73639&key=user_uploads/1124702/5bcc28c8-1998-4ebe-bcec-6a22a31ab085)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73639&key=user_uploads/1124702/846cf470-60c1-47cf-b404-a5d6e28988b2)

# **Why we built Magik**

Salesforce is complicated!\
CRMs and the customer data inside are essential for companies, yet most people don’t have experience with them. 

Junction objects, validation rules, and record-triggered flows sound confusing, and founders are intimidated. As a result, they turn to individuals with Salesforce certifications and address the problem in two main ways:

1. Hire a consultancy firm for $100-$200/hr. 
   1.  Your company hires an expensive consultant with misaligned incentives on how quickly the work should get done.
2. Hire an FTE

**Both of these solutions are slow to implement and expensive to maintain.**

# **Our Solution**

We leverage GPT models to streamline, simplify, and automate Salesforce workflows so that anyone can do the work of an expert-level RevOps employee. Our product allows users to build in Salesforce 15-25X quicker than before and receive recommendations they can automatically enable.

# **How does it work?**

* 🔗 **Connect** - Use Salesforce SSO to connect your environment to Magik.
* 📩 **Get Recommendations** - Once connected, Magik will make suggestions based on the event data in your environment.
* ✅ **Take action** -  Use natural language to describe your desired actions, and let Magik build them for you. Whether pulling data queries, automating workflows, or creating data visualizations, Magik helps you get it done in a fraction of the time.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73639&key=user_uploads/1124702/9b6beba2-25ff-4593-9ee2-71c73dd49de4)

We’d love to hear from you! 

If you currently use Salesforce or are considering it in the future, we could save you a significant amount of time and money 🙂, and ensure your CRM setup is perfect for your business.

You can email [founders@usemagik.com](mailto:founders@usemagik.com) for more information, grab time for a demo [here](https://calendly.com/danielmagik), and check out our [website](https://www.usemagik.com/).

name: Spine AI
long_description:
Spine AI is a visual workspace where a single prompt spins up a swarm of AI agents that plan, delegate, and execute complex tasks together — with humans fully in the loop.

Instead of chatting back and forth with one model, Spine breaks work into visible steps on a shared canvas. Agents collaborate in parallel, ask clarifying questions, use connected tools, and show their reasoning and intermediate outputs as they work.

Every agent’s work stays inspectable, auditable, and editable — reducing hallucinations and giving you real control over the outcome.

Spine connects to leading AI models and your existing tools, but the real power comes from orchestration: you act as the team lead, Spine runs the swarm.

Chat is great for answers. Spine is built for execution.
one_liner: Manage a swarm of AI agents to get real work done

launches.title: Medley: Give Claude Code missions, not just tasks
launches.tagline: Medley is a free Claude Code plugin for work bigger than one session. Type /mission to turn an outcome into a live dependency graph, coordinate Claude Code and Codex workers, review the assembled result, and keep going.
launches.body:
Hey YC! 👋 We're Akshay and Ashwin, and we're building Medley.

You type **_/mission_** and give it the outcome, the budget, and the constraints. Medley builds a live dependency graph, coordinates Claude Code and Codex workers, reviews what comes back, and keeps going when execution reveals more work. It's free and runs on the subscriptions and API access you already have.

<https://youtu.be/xe7bj3b5Aw0>

## **❌ The Problem**

Coding agents got good at bounded tasks. Once a job outgrows one session, you become the harness. You break the work into prompts, move context between agents, review outputs, and decide what happens next. There's no shared definition of done, so "finished" just means "looks finished."

## **🛠 Our Solution**

/mission takes on that orchestration. Three things sit between your outcome and the models:

* **A contract.** Before any work starts, Medley sets the objective, the acceptance criteria, the constraints and budget, and the conditions that should make it hold or stop. That's what "done" gets measured against later.
* **A live graph.** Medley doesn't write one giant plan upfront or spawn a swarm by default. It plans the next useful set of steps, runs them, reviews what came back, and updates what should happen next. Each node carries a brief, its dependencies, and a verification target. Sometimes one worker should carry a tightly coupled job end to end; when work is genuinely independent, Medley runs it in parallel. Work is routed across Claude Code and Codex workers - and with your own OpenRouter key, Codex workers can run models like Kimi and GLM.
* **An acceptance stage.** When a batch lands, a separate reviewer role inspects the outputs and changed files, runs the contract's verify commands, and decides whether the evidence satisfies the contract - not whether the work merely looks finished. If it doesn't, the mission replans.

You can watch and steer the mission in your browser. Anything that needs your judgment or approval - publishing, sending outbound, spending, contacting people - lands in the attention queue. Everything else keeps moving. 

## **📊 Why This Works**

The model is only the local capability. The harness decides where to apply it - the contract fixes the target, the graph splits the work, routing matches each task to a worker, and an independent acceptance stage runs the real verify commands and replans when the contract isn't met.

Before launch, we pressure-tested a benchmark-specialized version of the same architecture on four complete public benchmarks: 93.25% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 71.37 on HealthBench Professional, 93.24% on ViBench, and 60.98% on DrugDiscoveryBench. Those are the highest reported results on each, and they span coding, healthcare, and drug discovery.

No new foundation model. The gains came from how the work was decomposed, routed, carried across contexts, and reviewed.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108332&key=user_uploads/1362282/3af52f57-057a-475d-8bc4-ec0b1531a504)

Full methodology and results are[ on our blog](https://www.medley.sh/blog/the-harness-is-the-capability-multiplier).

## **🙏 Our Ask**

**Try it.** Medley is free on Mac. Install it from Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Spine-AI/medley
/plugin install medley
/reload-plugins
```

Then run /mission.[ ](http://medley.sh/)[medley.sh](http://medley.sh)

**Tell us what you think.** We're shaping the product around how people actually use it. Email [support@getspine.ai](mailto:support@getspine.ai) with what you tried, where it worked, and where it broke - and where you'd want Medley to keep going versus stop and ask.

launches.title: Spine Swarm: Your AI Team for Everything Beyond Code
launches.tagline: Spine gives you a team of AI agents that work together on a visual canvas to complete complex projects: research, analysis, financial models, prototypes, decks, and more.
launches.body:
Hey YC! 👋 We're Akshay and Ashwin, and we're building Spine Swarm.

**TL;DR**

You describe a project. A team of AI agents spins up, works in parallel on a visual canvas, and delivers finished outputs: market reports, financial models, slide decks, interactive prototypes. Free to get started, no setup needed.

**Ask:** Sign up and try it at[ ](https://www.getspine.ai/)[www.getspine.ai](http://www.getspine.ai). We'd love to hear what you build — drop us a note at [founders@getspine.ai](mailto:founders@getspine.ai).

<https://youtu.be/vylx9rzC388>

## **❌ The Problem**

AI agents for coding have crossed a threshold. Tools like Cursor and Claude Code let engineers describe a project and come back to finished, working code. That experience doesn't exist yet for the rest of the work that drives a company forward.

As coding gets increasingly automated, the bottleneck is moving upstream: strategy documents, competitive analysis, financial modeling, sales collateral, market research, SEO audits, rapid prototyping. These are multi-hour, multi-step projects that require pulling information from many sources, structuring it, and producing polished output.

Today's AI tools treat this kind of work as a conversation. You get a chat thread, local file management, and one model doing everything sequentially. For simple tasks that works fine. But for complex projects, the single-chat paradigm breaks down. You end up managing the AI instead of letting it manage the work.

We've been building at this intersection for 3 years. Last year we launched Spine Canvas, a visual workspace for orchestrating AI models. Swarm is the next step: the canvas now has autonomous agents that can take on entire projects from start to finish.

## **🛠 Our Solution**

Spine Swarm gives you a team of AI agents that work together on a visual canvas. You describe the project, and Spine spins up specialized agents in parallel, each handling a different part of the work. You can watch them execute in real time, inspect each artifact as it's created, and edit anything in place.

* **Multi-agent execution:** Spine orchestrates a team of agents across your project. For a competitive analysis, one agent researches market data, another structures the findings, another builds the slide deck. They work simultaneously, not sequentially, and can run autonomously for 80+ minutes on large projects.
* **Intelligent model selection:** We route between 300+ models, picking the best one for each step and ensembling multiple models to override any single model's biases. You don't configure any of this.
* **Visual canvas:** Every artifact your agents produce appears on a shared canvas where you can inspect, compare, edit, and branch. No chat windows, no file systems.

Everything Spine builds is downloadable and hosted at a shareable link. Just send your team the URL.

## **📊 Why This Works**

A common question we hear: "You're using the same models everyone else has access to. Why would the output be better?"

We recently scored **87.6% on Google DeepMind's DeepSearchQA**, a benchmark that measures how well AI answers complex research questions requiring multi-step reasoning across sources:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98705&key=user_uploads/1362282/fb8a5039-8780-455d-abc4-7f3da613aa7b)

Three things drive this:

* **Model routing and ensembling:** Spine selects the best model from 300+ options for each step and ensembles multiple models to override any single model's biases or blind spots.
* **Orchestration:** How you decompose a complex task, coordinate agents across steps, and manage handoffs between them matters as much as the models themselves.
* **Intelligent canvas:** Agents work on a shared canvas where they can read each other's outputs, build on previous steps, and assemble coherent deliverables. This also means every step is fully auditable, so you can trace how agents arrived at their conclusions and verify their reasoning.

Read more about our approach and the full benchmark results[ on our blog](https://blog.getspine.ai/spine-swarm-hits-1-on-gaia-level-3-and-google-deepmind-deepsearchqa/).

## **🚀 Tasks Worth Trying**

* "_Audit \[your website URL\] and produce a full SEO analysis, competitive landscape, and a prioritized growth roadmap with a slide deck._" You'll see agents browsing your site, researching competitors, and assembling deliverables simultaneously.
* "_I'm preparing to fundraise. Here are my company details: \[paste\]. Build me a pitch deck, competitive landscape with market sizing, a financial model, and personalized outreach emails for target investors._"
* "_Here's a product idea: \[describe it\]. Generate three different interactive prototypes and landing pages exploring different design directions, alongside a PRD and go-to-market strategy._"

## **🙏 Our Ask**

* **Try it:** Sign up at[ ](https://www.getspine.ai/)[www.getspine.ai](http://www.getspine.ai) and run one of the tasks above. It's free to get started, no credit card required.
* **Tell us what you build:** We're actively shaping the product around how people actually use it. Email us at [founders@getspine.ai](mailto:founders@getspine.ai) with what you tried and how it went.

**Share this post** if you know founders, operators, or team leads drowning in the strategic and analytical work that's piling up as code writes itself.

launches.title: Spine Canvas: Unlimited Visual Workspace for AI Thinking
launches.tagline: Think beyond chat. Collaborate visually across 300+ AI models with branching, parallel, and contextual workflows.
launches.body:
tl;dr: Chat is great for Q&A, but real work isn’t linear.

**Spine Canvas** is an unlimited, visual AI workspace that lets you orchestrate 300+ models with a single subscription, think in blocks (Chat, Deep Research, Memo, Image, Slides), branch safely, run in parallel, and keep explicit context across everything.

Get started for free:[ ](https://www.getspine.ai/)https://www.getspine.ai

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBq6dDQlO5w 

### **❌ The Problem**

Most AI tools force thinking into a chat thread. That breaks down for real work:

* **Superficial and linear:** useful for one-off answers, weak for exploration and synthesis
* **Context evaporates:** sources get buried; you can’t see what informed which step
* **No safe branching:** testing alternatives means losing your original path (or forking tabs)
* **No parallelism:** ideas wait in line; you can’t spin up multiple streams at once
* **Tool sprawl:** one app for research, another for writing, another for images — context gets lost between multiple AI subscriptions

If you’re doing market/competitive research, strategy, content systems, or product planning, you need an environment that reflects how thinking actually happens: exploratory, non-linear, and iterative.

---

### **💡 Our Solution: Canvas, Not Chat**

Spine Canvas is a visual workspace where your ideas are blocks connected by explicit context. You can see, direct, branch, and re-run your thinking — across hundreds of models — without losing your train of thought.

#### What you can do today:

**Orchestrate 300+ models with a single subscription**

GPT‑5, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Flux, Nano Banana, and more — pick the right model per step and switch mid‑flow without losing context.

**Think in blocks, not threads**

Chat, Prompt, Deep Research, Memo, Image, Slides — each block has an explicit role and visual inputs/outputs, so chains stay modular and interpretable.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94642&key=user_uploads/1222057/d6578fed-e2e5-4e9d-a749-a58b8ab47ccd)

**Organize and (explicitly) utilize all your content in a single workspace**

Paste or drop in PDFs, YouTube links, webpages, and even past LLM chats. Wire them into any block and control exactly what each step uses.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94642&key=user_uploads/1222057/1e4420c0-d1a2-46fa-82db-cdf54eb15827)

**Branch safely and compare**

Explore alternatives without corrupting your original path. Keep versions side‑by‑side and merge insights when you’re ready.

**Run in parallel**

Take a list (competitors, themes, tasks) and spin out multiple research streams, drafts, or visuals at once.

**Re‑run and evolve**

Update one block and cascade improvements through an entire branch. Iteration becomes automatic and reproducible.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94642&key=user_uploads/1222057/47204045-5cb7-477e-afc9-55a447f0e165)

Our public roadmap:[ app.getspine.ai/roadmap](https://app.getspine.ai/roadmap)

### **💼 Real Canvases Teams Are Building**

* Market deep‑dives that flow into competitor profiles, battlecards, and executive memos — in minutes, not days
* Content engines that turn one source into outlines, drafts, and platform‑ready assets (with visuals)
* Founder/product strategy rooms mapping interviews (YouTube + PDFs) → insights → counterpoints → product bets → launch plans
* Creative labs exploring concepts, visual directions, and brand systems
* Learning hubs with curated sources, summaries, and living notes

Explore our gallery:[ https://app.getspine.ai/gallery](https://app.getspine.ai/gallery)

### **⚙️ Why This Matters**

* **Transparency:** See what each block knows — no black-box memory.
* **Control:** Direct sources by domain, date, or type; include your own docs and past chats.
* **Speed:** Complex, multi-step work finishes in minutes and stays repeatable.
* **Flexibility:** Model-agnostic orchestration keeps your workflow stable as models evolve.
* **Complete**: Do everything from research to generating presentation slides, images, copy drafts, all without switching tools.

Chat works for Q&A. **Canvas is for thinking.**

### **🤝 Ask**

* Try using a canvas for thinking instead of linear chat threads – build one real workflow (research → memo, content engine, or strategy room) and tell us what clicked.
* Share with teams who live in research, strategy, content, product or learnOps – we’re eager to add more templates based on your feedback.
* YC community: we’re always happy to chat about getting the best thinking out of your AI models — visually for individual workflows, and structurally through company-wide templates.

**Get started for free:**[ ](https://www.getspine.ai)[getspine.ai](http://getspine.ai)

**Join the community:**[ discord.gg/KuHzF6zBPs](https://discord.gg/KuHzF6zBPs)

**Book a chat:**[ calendly.com/intro-getspine/intro](https://calendly.com/intro-getspine/intro)

\
The future of human–AI collaboration is visual, adaptive, and unlimited.

launches.title: Spine Research: Deep research done better
launches.tagline: Iterative deep research reports you can actually use.
launches.body:
**tl;dr** Spine Research searches through **_over 3x more sources 5x faster than ChatGPT Deep Research while keeping you in control_**. With a built-in full-text editor, you can iteratively guide the research, dive deeper into topics, and build and share reports that are actually useful.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cabKW-B9Ung

# ❌ **The Problem**

“Deep research” with AI often isn’t comprehensive, collaborative or controlled. If you’re relying on research for critical decisions, you’ve probably run up against the limitations of current tools:

* **Superficial Overviews:** Most AI tools deliver surface-level summaries. While a starting point, they rarely deliver the nuanced, comprehensive understanding needed for a true competitive edge or complex problem-solving.
* **Static Reports, Not Evolving Understanding:** Real insight comes from asking new questions based on what you're learning, and using that to inform where you need to go next. What if the initial research misses the mark, or you want to explore a specific avenue further? You're often stuck waiting 10-15+ minutes for a complete do-over, losing valuable context and any useful initial findings. Current UX isn't built for the way human understanding evolves – through continuous _refinement_ and building upon prior knowledge.
* **Lack of Meaningful Control:** Struggling to direct AI to your trusted websites, specific authors, or crucial internal documents? Or to exclude irrelevant noise? You end up sifting through low-quality information, wasting time and effort, because you can't effectively steer the research. It's hard to restrict research to just research papers, recent news or local government websites.

 For critical decision-making and professional analysis, today's AI "deep research" often feels frustratingly superficial, rigid, and disconnected from your own expertise.

# 💡 **Our Solution**

Spine AI rapidly generates comprehensive research reports by synthesizing insights from hundreds of websites, academic papers, news articles, and private documents—delivering deeper, more accurate understanding in a fraction of the time taken by ChatGPT's Deep Research. 

You're in full control to iteratively define the scope, depth, and breadth of analysis to perfectly suit your needs.

1. **Guide your process from the start:**\
   Start with your prompt and guide the research process immediately. Spine AI generates an initial outline you can quickly edit. Refine its scope, focus, or sources in minutes, ensuring precise alignment _before_ full report generation, so you don’t have to wait 15 minutes to realize you forgot to include a key detail about scope.

   ![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcL5A3u_PiTNIcT2zA_EuBzfnd1KkxzSX96-X_IXZip1X55JeOpSlewO6VSh2UnshndNmMQ0CIQLX2AJXZnl63DSKevcmLfEEZbmYFx4kNp4hSAMh6O8fSbOreW-syDJtskuGvYWg?key=Y1LxsXqmD3SyMDO0vvbfTw)

2. **Control the process and build your understanding iteratively:**
   * **Breadth of sources:** When searching the open web, Spine AI accesses over 3x more sources than ChatGPT’s deep research, giving you a more comprehensive view with detailed citations out of the box. You can also exclude irrelevant domains, keeping unreliable sources out of your reports.
   * **Focused discovery:** Direct Spine AI to focus on particular types of sources (like news, financial reports, or research papers), specific websites, and set publication timeframes, to ensure the most relevant information.
   * **Leverage your own sources:** Upload and research your own private documents—proprietary reports, project files, spreadsheets, slide decks—integrating your internal knowledge with external discovery.
   * **Model Agnostic:** Maintain flexibility by choosing the LLM (including OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini models) that best suits your current needs or preferences. Your core research workflow remains stable, even as individual model capabilities evolve.

   ![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcT9SBLuKPWhEOCBukznBQTa76nsdbme7j2Tid7-TYTDxW-fxfMF37AHn7GwxQBR-b5E1rxcu9GWpjbdKWLgcoJV7q9SMyH0-ToypIKq63YfCWSBg1BTjXOle7IUb4h_GZ-DaGjJw?key=Y1LxsXqmD3SyMDO0vvbfTw)

3. **Directly add your expertise:**\
   Spine AI isn't just about AI-generated content; it's a dynamic working document. You can type directly into your research, add your own notes, edit the generated text, and incorporate your unique context and analysis alongside the AI's findings. Close the gap between just another research doc to organize, and actually creating a usable report, or project doc.

# 🤝 **The Ask**

**Put us to the test.**

Need to build quick expertise on a new topic or simplify your research process?. Find out about how the [recent executive order on drug pricing could shift the market](https://research.getspine.ai/reports/62ab8a56-e0d5-4380-a991-18bf4fc2ffd0?utm_campaign=bookface), [what US-China trade negotiations could mean for startups and VC](https://research.getspine.ai/reports/0ee2928d-e0c9-4aea-b277-45f347d2b07d?utm_campaign=bookface), or [where Stripe is sitting in the market](https://research.getspine.ai/reports/105e8d40-36fc-4092-8555-853cf5865b40?utm_campaign=bookface). Also great for getting a handle on the latest research ([how much do we really know about ozempic?](https://research.getspine.ai/reports/ff4177f6-105f-4954-9fdd-a50261beae32?utm_campaign=bookface)), or whatever else you have questions about.

**Try us out for free!**

And with the YC promo code (YCLAUNCH), you can get $25 off our pro plans.

Know a founder, investor, analyst, or tech enthusiast who needs better research tools? Let them know about Spine AI. **Share with deep research power users**, and see if they don’t want to make the switch.

launches.title: Spine AI – The Multi-Modal AI Analyst Platform for Reliable Insights
launches.tagline: Simplifying data exploration at scale with AI analysts tailored to your business context
launches.body:
# Tl;dr

Accessing and synthesizing data is a challenge, with existing tools requiring too much effort and expertise.

**Enter Spine**: An AI-powered data platform built for decision-makers that handles your data in any format. Teach it your business context, to get reliable answers from databases, documents, and websearch. Gather your insights in customizable reports that automate multi-modal analysis and keep insights traceable.

To celebrate F24 Demo Day, **we’re offering free access** to a YC dataset in Spine, giving investors and observers a deep dive into batch F24’s companies, founders, and opportunities.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/425f4b5e-1eb5-48a6-bf02-25e69412564d)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/365e8fa7-e9c5-4489-adb3-281393120488)

# The problem

There is no shortage of data and information, or reasons to access it. Improving operations, identifying the most successful initiatives, or clarifying key drivers of revenue. But accessing and synthesizing this information from various sources can be an uphill battle.

Many tools available for working with data make it difficult to get to the right information without significant time and effort. Technical experts often have to unlock access for decision makers, and even then, critical details locked in documents, slide decks, or PDFs are hard to uncover and integrate effectively. 

While platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini offer “chat with your data” functionality—such as answering questions about uploaded spreadsheets or generating text-to-SQL queries—they don’t go far enough. None of these solutions offer an end to end solution that’s suitable for scalable use.

**You need to already have the right data, in a clean format, and not too much.** The big LLM providers can find some new information for you, but it can’t give you structured data at scale, and it’s not up to date.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/243f0c39-bd31-4246-9230-a330465ccdd1)

**It’s not enough to just do text to SQL.** It can speed up querying, but there’s a lot of business context that needs to be applied to make answers accurate and useful, and Custom GPTs don’t cut it. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86064&key=user_uploads/1222057/7f42be7d-d2d5-434c-8854-37792f39dc9d)

**There’s no good way to update information, add more data, or deal with multiple formats and sources at the same time.** People often don’t know the best place to find the information they are looking for, and most LLMs can’t help with that at scale.

**You can’t easily collect the insights you’ve generated from LLMs, share them, or re-trace your steps if there are questions about the source.** If you want to replicate a similar process for your analysis there’s no straightforward way, especially if it involves multi-modal data.

The major BI and analytics tools solve some of these problems, but they don’t really deliver on conversational functionality, and definitely don’t support multi-modality.

Which is why we’ve built a better way.

# The solution

Spine is a multi-modal AI analyst platform designed for decision-makers, delivering an end to end solution which includes:

**Explore and enrich data**

* Either start from scratch or add on to your existing data. Combine structured data, documents, and websearch for a unified view.
* Pull in data for competitive analysis, market research, benchmarking and more.

**Domain knowledge management customized for your use case, and ongoing evaluations for reliable updates**

* Our platform makes it possible to adjust, and test the integration of domain knowledge at scale, so you know updates work and are an improvement over what came before. 
* We generate 1000s of samples for each of our analysts, capturing issues so we can solve them, and know objectively that our changes improve performance.

**Integrations for your existing data sources**

* We work with data of all types, integrating with platforms like Google Drive, BigQuery and Snowflake, and industry specific tools like iLevel. Any tool that has an API can be set up.

**Transparent answers for users**

* Our AI analysts always show their work, so users can verify where answers are coming from and how they were created.
* If the analyst finds a question it’s not confident in answering, it notifies the user and gives them the option to submit to a human to verify its work.

**Customizable reporting and repeatable analysis**

* Full control and flexibility in reports and dashboards. Insights can be added directly from the chat, gathering information from structured datasets and documents.
* Create templates to automate multi-modal analysis, enabling you to apply the same framework seamlessly across multiple entities, such as different companies or similar data sets.

**In honour of Demo Day**, we’ve put together a [free preview of Spine](https://yc.getspine.ai/sign-up) with a dataset for batch F24’s companies and founders (plus as a bonus, data on all YC companies). 

If you’re an investor:

* Track the companies you’re interested in, and create a more focused view to compare them.
* Upload pitch decks and documents from founders to enrich the dataset we’ve given you, and pull key insights from them, such as traction, TAM estimates and GTM strategy.

launches.title: Spine AI - Reliable AI data analysts that know your business
launches.tagline: Custom AI analysts, trained on your business context, so you can ask truly plain language data questions and make informed decisions frictionlessly
launches.body:
## tl;dr

Spine creates reliable AI analysts that make it easy to get the right data to drive decisions. We capture and embed your business context, to enable real plain language data questions. Instead of spending time struggling with inflexible dashboards, or translating questions to queries, just ask questions and get answers. Empower internal decision makers, or your customers, with interface options that integrate with existing workflows.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdtqKjuSuQpHE3TjAm_itXPgRLQtQgySxCTM0ReLQsAw3Gp_7wvbUIcGzUlUdy_WnNHsxizF0yn7oyA3Eb6ompQWp1RItXp80w1zaZWFZoAZgUQ4-Yk36b65S3_8LSTE5QTYAdgjqKrhkkzSBg6ZF45FUg?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

# The problem

From having built over 200 copilots for companies and having processed more than 100k user queries here are some of our key learnings:

* Analytics and business intelligence are critical to running any organization. They allow leaders to understand what’s working, what’s not, and where they can find new opportunities.
* Most existing BI tools are inflexible and technical. To find answers to novel questions requires knowledge of the data model, or a BI specific query language.
* In practice, it's not always obvious what you'll need to know to respond to an evolving situation, or what new questions your data will raise. Static reports and dashboards create dead ends. You can get stuck waiting for someone from the data team to be available, or having to act on best guesses.
* And it's not just internal decision makers who face these challenges. Your customers can only interact with their application data through:
  * static dashboards that require engineering teams to build,
  * custom reports your support teams and analysts put together, and/or
  * data exports that require expertise to dissect
* While the extraction of information from unstructured sources has evolved, handling structured data remains a challenge:
  * Beyond accurately deciphering user intent, structured data often comes with messy table schemas and unwritten business context, for which there are no established methods of embedding in the models.
  * Simply having models generate complex SQL and/or code to process the data makes the execution less transparent, flexible and reliable.
  * Isolating data across multiple tenants and user access controls remains a barrier in making this a customer facing feature.

## The solution

We build custom AI analysts that allow any user to ask plain language questions about their data, and get reliable answers.

**Plain language questions and natural exploration**

With the chat interface, users can easily explore their data, asking questions in their own words, instead of "translating them" to a formal query. When the results raise new questions, just ask them. No searching for the right report, or getting stuck at a deadend in your dashboard.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXezHViIBc3TQimN4FoYsmGAuqFJ_lFgAQU8rTAGqPTGqoQmaN1l_FIxEwl8RvNWwRNJDQrVqL3w1ur0ziFjU069dzbYTwvorccXTDYPsPjD4CSqnRUMWnu4s89MT5Lgy-XfA3dqZJ5XunVddCXzeh97aw?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

**Revisit crucial insights**

Once you’ve found insights in your data, it’s easy to come back to. Get regular notifications for key questions, collect insights into shareable reports, or add them to flexible dashboards.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXefxA1bWXpTkzW8hQBEekKMhZ4W3KPKIdetddq-1FWALX804CujEpigd2dQJjFVsEYVqE8MTsMRRzJ9mB6ahQkKQ7Rpxatwyp8AUgaVdLWKz0B8neUCiXXWM6uQbQWQXeFOwBBVHNETGCQGvQa5U1TJUrc?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

**Transparent and reliable answers**

Even on a single table dataset Spine’s AI analyst performs 15x better than GPT-4o out of the box.

Rather than leveraging models to generate complex SQL or code (or find answers from the data directly), our solution leverages a proprietary Data Processing Unit (DPU) that comprises a collection of refined modules.

The DPU enables us to:

* have individually tested and schema/domain fine-tuned modules that work at scale
* react to the data and modify the operations we take to get the answer
* explain the steps taken by the AI in a simple human readable manner

During the customer onboarding process, we capture and embed the business context and the schema understanding into the DPU modules. Additionally we build and maintain data and schema-specific semantic layers, across tables, which makes it possible for us to accurately interpret and handle natural language questions across multiple tables with over millions of rows each.

Finally, a combination of automated and human evaluations give us an objective way of measuring performance — both before and after we deploy the analyst.

**Diverse use cases**

We are able to support use cases across diverse industries and user bases by systematically gathering domain specific knowledge from our customers, and automatically inferring relevant data characteristics. Whether you’re in finance, retail, healthcare, telecoms, manufacturing, or any other industry, we can create an AI analyst for your business.

**_Sales analyst_**

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdfoY8qAC_h6o37VqJhc9laUNLLsm2WoauY11Wzkq5Xn30kUo3sOqSGh5QQh8Z0In23MiAu5rTmss7DsZEFkpNUqwbVjH8-7lkmjcQTWE03g1U_Ce7bU_J5Tnaa34Om9RUW7onhyfiMfZBYYDhIg2bv82s?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

Understand what outreach activities are getting attention, with who. Dig into team member performance, email deliverability and more, to better understand what’s effective and what’s not performing.

**_eCommerce platform analyst_**

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdmVxwj3U-ohPX90hds_V_0qkRzBioVUgAOa7mZn0dJb3Bds-NSWsJAI2bfrQSnwVkAlwQ9n_KxmSXWXouOgqy4Tof9-GabGM6CC36-DMWTw53EJt8TuP5AYKCIJhxhWsXsU_aO9V0ZimmY5AW4FzW6Gg?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

Gain insights into which products are selling the most and why. Analyze customer behavior, optimize inventory management, and uncover trends in purchase patterns to maximize your sales potential.

**_ERP system analyst_**

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd_waVQSpbeRpOB3ZZjq_YGuu4scesyVCwj7txYLLoy6oyIzVUoSxEKyDuvkkjnXfG3JekB8U5Oq_I_wsbfAQSxLtdNw2QHrm6Yu9HQfmNQ5lMv7fLm1Sduavs0PyO3Fie2eqHih2I4amlPDb8exr_dy3I?key=nI0vqYTeqq8Yopi3is-LAg)

Keep projects on track by monitoring task progress, timelines, and budget adherence. Evaluate project performance, identify risks, and ensure timely delivery of project milestones.

**The power and flexibility of AI without needing a technical team**

You don’t need your own AI team. Have your custom analyst up and running in the next 30 days, and leave the upkeep to us. Monitor and tune the analyst’s behavior over time with our admin panel.

# About us

We are Akshay and Ashwin – the co-founders of Spine AI 👋. We've been friends for over a decade, with our shared journey beginning at the University of Waterloo. Our interest in machine learning took root in an unlikely place – a building called _Spine_ at the Nanyang Technological University in Singapore during an exchange term.

And in our first year we’ve grown! Across our team, we collectively collaborated with more than 45 enterprises, guiding them toward the next levels of AI maturity. We have more than 100+ citations in GenAI and patents in AI and data processing. Our team also has experience working at companies like Nvidia, Shopify, Instacart, Amazon, Epic Games as well as founding multiple YC companies.

* Enter Spine AI – the easiest way to build reliable AI copilots for your products. Our platform converts API docs, DB schemas, and multi-modal documents into fully operational AI copilots that integrate effortlessly with just a few lines of code.

launches.title: Capi Money - International payments for importers in Africa
launches.tagline: Helping businesses in Africa pay their international suppliers
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Capi Money](https://capimoney.com) and we help businesses in Africa pay their international suppliers. Importers in Africa pay up to 10% to settle international invoices and wait weeks for their payments to arrive. We’re giving businesses in Africa the same price and speed as we expect in the US and Europe.

**We recently launched in Senegal** 🇸🇳 and have booked over $1.5m of payments in our first two weeks. We’re launching Cameroon this month and are currently scoping out Egypt.

### **😫 The problem our first customer experienced**

Two weeks ago Mitch and Scott (2/3 of the founding team) were in Senegal visiting our local agent-distributor, and onboarding our first customers: a bookshop and an industrial soap-maker.

The former imports books from Europe and sells them in Dakar. All their revenue is in local currency (XOF) but their supplier invoices are in Euros. They’ve struggled to pay these invoices as:

* Either the bank doesn’t have any Euros to sell them or if they can find Euros elsewhere (e.g. a broker), they pay 5%-10% in FX fees; and
* They have to wait weeks and sometimes months for payments to reach their suppliers, which risks their being cut off by their supplier for late payment.

We provide an alternative source of foreign currency by finding organisations that are sending money into Senegal and therefore want XOF and are willing to trade Euros for it. All of this happens behind the scenes and all they need to do is create the transaction in our online platform and send us the XOF, just like a US business using Wise or Payoneer.

### **👋 A bit about us**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73937&key=user_uploads/386554/aedb1a43-f231-4fb4-a6b4-4481c1ce0cc3)

Mitch (right) and Scott (middle) met at Taptap Send, a remittance app that sends billions into Africa and Asia every year. There they were COO/CFO and CRO/CMO, and have spent a decade each working in emerging markets. Tom (left) is a 3rd-time founder having been co-founder and CTO at Hubble (a B2B marketplace) and P4SD (a web3 NFT company).

### **🙏 How you can help**

Get in touch if you or anyone you know is:

* A business in Africa making regular international payments;
* An international exporter, selling goods or services into Africa;
* A business regularly sending funds into Africa (e.g. remittance firm, HR/payroll company)

You can either sign up to transact on our website (<https://capimoney.com>), or reach out to us at [founders@capimoney.com](mailto:founders@capimoney.com)

launches.title: SID.ai – AI research lab for retrieval
launches.tagline: AI research lab for retrieval
launches.body:
**Intelligence needs Context**

AI is giving humanity a new computer: one that can learn, reason, and act. But intelligence and skills are inconsequential without context. _Context imposes the upper bound._ At SID, we're training models to provide this context. _To connect intelligence to the world._

**Context needs Retrieval**

To provide the right context, you need to find it first: Humanity has known how to do search on the internet for a while. But great search over everything else has been elusive so far. We think _we have an angle to solve it once and for all_. [SID-1](https://www.sid.ai/research/sid-1), our first agentic retrieval model, doubles embedding-only accuracy and outperforms frontier models on the most complex retrieval tasks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72952&key=user_uploads/1134710/cd8dc357-3db7-4db0-9476-265e176bb6bb)

**SID-1**

_SID-1 is our first model for agentic retrieval: 1.8x more likely to surface the right results than embedding-only search across general knowledge, finance, science, legal, and email. It is more accurate than agentic retrieval based on Gemini 3 Pro, Sonnet 4.5, and GPT-5.1 at its highest compute setting, while being 24x faster (144 vs 5.7 seconds)._

Traditional retrieval pipelines pre-program each step: query rewriting, searching, reranking. SID-1 retrieves like a human would: it searches, reads results, and refines its queries, taking as many steps as needed. We trained SID-1 on questions that take human researchers over an hour to solve.

SID-1 is drop-in compatible with existing retrieval systems. It is designed to work as a subagent with larger LLMs like GPT-5 or Sonnet. Teams running embedding-only retrieval or RAG can typically integrate it in an afternoon.

Step-change improvements in retrieval create new winners. Claude Code was better at finding the right file, unlocking larger code bases and driving massive adoption for Anthropic. Open Evidence made retrieving over medical research easier and took doctors by storm. Looking back further, relational was better than hierarchical for databases, creating Oracle. Better web search created Google. [_We're working closely with a small group of companies who want that edge now for their domains._](https://tally.so/r/gDDVMd)

Given we're compute-limited, we're rolling SID-1 out slowly. We're offering SID-1 through our API, AWS Bedrock, and as a self-hosted model. _If you're interested in SID-1, please sign up to our [waitlist](https://tally.so/r/gDDVMd), follow us on [X](https://x.com/SID_AI), or read the [technical report](https://www.sid.ai/research/sid-1-technical-report) for more details._

name: Alguna
long_description:
We are Alguna, building a modern platform that helps B2B companies price deals, send quotes, bill customers, and collect payments - all in one place.

Our mission is to create the most efficient revenue engine for B2B SaaS.

Today, many companies run these processes with spreadsheets and a patchwork of separate tools. That leads to slow approvals, manual work, mistakes, and missed revenue—especially as pricing gets more complex.

Alguna replaces that mess by connecting the entire flow from **quote to cash**: what sales sells becomes what finance bills, automatically. We help teams automate invoicing, handle usage-based or custom pricing, and reduce back-and-forth between sales, finance, and engineering.

The result: growth-stage startups and enterprises can close deals faster, bill accurately, and scale revenue operations without adding headcount or building internal systems.
one_liner: AI-Native CPQ & Billing for Modern Pricing Models

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
**What is the core problem that Alguna solves?**

B2B companies struggle to turn what sales sells into what finance can reliably bill and collect.

Pricing, quoting, contracts, usage, invoicing, and payments often live in different tools—and the “glue” is spreadsheets, manual approvals, and one-off engineering work. As soon as a company introduces custom terms (discounts, ramps, multi-year deals, usage-based pricing, credits, multi-entity billing), the process breaks down: quotes don’t match invoices, billing becomes manual, and finance is stuck cleaning up exceptions every month.

Alguna solves this by providing a single platform that unifies **pricing, CPQ, billing, invoicing, payments, usage metering, and collections automation** into one **quote-to-revenue** system.

**Why is this a big problem?**

Because revenue operations scale poorly when the infrastructure is fragmented.

The impact is measurable:

\- **Revenue leakage:** missed invoices, incorrect pricing, unbilled usage, and manual errors compound over time.

\- **Slower deal cycles:** approvals and “can we even bill this?” questions delay closing.

\- **High operational cost:** finance and revops teams spend their time reconciling systems instead of controlling revenue.

\- **Engineering dependency:** product teams get pulled into custom billing logic, integrations, and edge cases.

\- **Harder forecasting and reporting:** when the source of truth is scattered, finance cannot trust the numbers.

As more companies adopt **usage-based**, **hybrid**, and **AI-driven** pricing models, the gap between modern monetization and legacy revenue stacks keeps widening.

**What made you decide to work on it?**

We saw the same pattern across fast-growing B2B teams: the product and go-to-market motion moves quickly, but the revenue stack stays stuck in old systems built for simpler subscriptions.

Teams end up running “mission-critical revenue” on spreadsheets and disconnected tools—because replacing them is painful, and building in-house is expensive and distracting. Yet the cost of doing nothing is continuous: every custom deal creates more manual work, more risk, and more leakage.

Alguna exists to modernize that foundation. We’re building the revenue management engine B2B companies need to sell flexibly, bill accurately, and scale without chaos—by unifying the quote-to-revenue lifecycle and automating the back office.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
We will know Alguna succeeded when **B2B monetization stops being a patchwork of spreadsheets, PDFs, and disconnected tools**—and becomes a single, programmable revenue engine that companies can run with speed, precision, and confidence.

The world today is stuck with legacy revenue stacks that were built for simpler subscription businesses. Meanwhile, selling is changing fast: companies sell across **PLG (self-serve), SLG (custom quotes), and enterprise procurement**, pricing models are shifting toward **usage, hybrid, credits, and outcome-based**, and deep integrations + two-way sync across systems are becoming table stakes. In that environment, “good enough” billing and CPQ breaks down.

Alguna’s vision is to become the **one source of truth for revenue**—the system that orchestrates pricing, quoting, contracting, usage, billing, invoicing, payments, and collections end-to-end.\
\
What will be different about the world

**1) Revenue operations becomes “real-time” and automated**

* Quotes turn into clean billing schedules automatically.
* Usage becomes billable without manual reconciliation.
* Invoices and collections run with far fewer human interventions.

launches.body:
# **📝 TL;DR:**

> [Alguna](https://alguna.io) is a modern pricing, quoting, and billing platform for B2B SaaS. Companies use it to unify the quote-to-revenue process by automating complex and manual back-office operations. [Book a demo](https://alguna.io) to learn more.

# **❌ Problem**

As companies grow, they want to offer more customized deals to their larger customers, capture data around product usage, forecast revenue, and experiment with pricing. As they scale, instead of graduating to better tools, they default to using spreadsheets and manual processes to connect single-point solutions.

After interviewing over 100 company leaders, we’ve seen what consequences information siloes and fragmented solutions can have on the companies’ growth trajectories. \
From light issues like hiring people to copy/paste data between systems to fundamental ones like not trusting your revenue data or asking your customers to tell you how much they used your product.

> _In times of growth at all costs, companies could’ve turned a blind eye to these imperfect workflows; however, as 2023 loomed over the whole SaaS world, these revenue-impacting inefficiencies represent the line between company survival and the slow death of running out of money without even realizing it._

# ✅ **How Alguna works**

Our core premise is to enable our customers (growth-stage startups and enterprises) to flexibly close more deals faster without worrying about internal limitations and relying on finance and engineering teams.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76099&key=user_uploads/1225753/9b1a2f85-6a49-4420-8839-23d7193526fa)

> We’ve built **an end-to-end solution** covering the whole customer lifecycle while **complementing** existing **sales** (CRMs), **finance** (ERPs/Accounting), and **engineering** tools.

**Configure pricing & create custom quotes**

* Set up pricing and packaging across all sales channels while supporting any pricing model (including subscriptions, usage-based, platform fees, etc.)
* Create the most customizable plan options with custom product billing options, one-off integration fees, special discounts, and complex renewal terms.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76099&key=user_uploads/1225753/d5c62cfa-bb64-45bd-b544-4ff878cbc363)

**Streamline the contract signature flow**\
Alguna provides an embedded signature experience directly from the proposal you send customers. This is then automatically connected to tools upstream (CRMs) and downstream (ERPs), enabling the cohesive external (prospects/customers) and internal experience.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76099&key=user_uploads/1225753/f722da69-f9ef-4655-be51-676d57731dbb)

**Seamless and reliable invoicing experience**\
Since the pricing models and quotes are natively integrated, everything is automatically connected with the billing engine, enabling the accurate and reliable customer billing experience directly via Alguna or ERP tools of your choice (Stripe Invoicing, Netsuite, Xero, Quickbooks, Bill)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76099&key=user_uploads/1225753/8802ecb0-928d-4ff8-9bf2-d6593fae75a3)

**Source of truth for revenue metrics** \
Empower sales and customer success teams with usage data to drive more revenue and unlock new upsell opportunities with real-time revenue data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76099&key=user_uploads/1225753/f34387fc-134a-471f-bba3-0d38d1e992f8)

# **🏟️ Why us**

We ([@Jamie MacLeod](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jamie-macleod/) & [@Aleks Đekić](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aleksdjekic/)) met at a fintech startup where we helped scale the payments and automation teams and products. While trying to launch new products, we experienced this problem firsthand and decided to solve it once and for all. Previously, [@Aleks](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aleksdjekic/) led the product development of internal tools _just like_ Alguna for a 600-person commercial team at one of Europe's fastest-growing payment processing companies.

launches.body:
**TL;DR**

Most Series A+ tech companies still manage revenue recognition, attribution (expansion, churn, etc.), and KPIs in spreadsheets. Campfire simplifies the entire process by ingesting your revenue data (customer contracts, Stripe data, etc.) through AI to automate your revenue recognition, invoice management and KPI reporting for any business model (subscription, usage, marketplace, etc.). We’re currently performing the data migration (at no cost!) for new customers through the end of August. Check us out at [meetcampfire.com](http://meetcampfire.com)!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73767&key=user_uploads/815940/5446f7b9-e256-4832-9844-aeca965da002)

_Quick tour of our dashboard page_

**How we know this is a problem**\
As an exec at Invoice2go (90 employees, Series C), one of the largest pain points [John](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/815940) encountered was that the company had outgrown QuickBooks, but the migration to NetSuite didn’t make sense due to pricing, resourcing and the required migration effort. After selling the company to and leading partnerships at [Bill.com](http://Bill.com), John noticed significant innovation happening around core accounting (Brex, Zip, Rippling, etc), but accounting software itself like NetSuite hadn’t been refreshed in 20+ years.

At the same time, [Fernando](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/847698) led back-end engineering at Trovata, which is treasury software for customers like Square and Etsy. He realized there was an opportunity to bring enterprise-grade automation to mid-size companies.

Bringing our experiences together, we know that we can make a difference in an area that hasn’t seen improvements in decades. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73767&key=user_uploads/815940/eab61627-c57c-4806-a75c-2dbc58c577db)

_This was the moment when it sunk in that we’re really in Y Combinator!_

**Our Solution**\
To fix this inefficiency, we’ve launched _Revenue Management_ as our first product. We’re migrating accounting and finance teams out of spreadsheets and into automated, AI-powered software that ingests customer contracts and computes revenue recognition and KPIs (ARR, churn, etc.) to improve accuracy, saving both time and money. Early customers are saving 90% of the time it takes to manage revenue, allowing their accounting/finance teams to focus on high-value, impactful work instead of performing manual tasks in spreadsheets. Your investor/Board updates just got a lot better, and your accounting teams just got a lot more efficient. Our product is fully operational for any business model and referenceable with happy campers (pun intended!) like Jenny Jao, Head of Finance at Sprig (Series B) who said:

> Our time-to-value with Campfire was really fast. We're moving our revenue and invoice management out of spreadsheets and into Campfire to automate everything. It's a big win for us.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73767&key=user_uploads/815940/ea2da31f-8ee9-4c14-8ac5-41c21ac29be9)

_View of a customer contract_

Campfire works well for any business model from marketplaces managing hundreds of thousands of monthly transactions in a database to enterprise subscription software managing contracts in spreadsheets. Irrespective of business model, Campfire automates your revenue KPI’s for investor/exec updates and monthly journal entry for any accounting software such as QuickBooks and NetSuite. 

**Our ask:** We’re looking to connect with finance and accounting leaders at Series A+ tech companies to explore how Campfire can save them between one day and one week every month, while turning the lights on their revenue KPIs to improve exec reporting and investor updates.

**Launch YC Promo:** \
We’re currently performing the entire data migration out of spreadsheets (at no cost!) for new customers through the end of August. Upon first login, view all of your revenue KPIs, attribution, and customer- and product-level revenue analysis with the ability to drill down into the data. Reduce your revenue accounting down to a few clicks per month, and increase your efficiency. 📈

**Check out our website at **[**meetcampfire.com**](http://meetcampfire.com)**, drop me a note at **[**john@meetcampfire.com**](mailto:john@meetcampfire.com)**, or **[**schedule a demo**](https://www.meetcampfire.com/company/meet-campfire)** to get started.**

**tl;dr:** [Parea AI](https://www.parea.ai/) automates the creation of evals for your AI products. We achieve this by bootstrapping an evaluation function with human annotations. Allowing you to automagically turn “vibe checks” into scalable and reliable evaluations aligned with human judgment.

# **😩 The Problem**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82145&key=user_uploads/501039/78024ed1-9aa2-4be8-a022-359d82b9ac59)

Evaluating free-form text is often only possible by humans reviewing outputs or using LLMs to evaluate them. The former is laborious, slow, and expensive, while the latter often fails to evaluate the outputs correctly. For LLM evaluations to work properly, one needs to prompt engineer them; i.e., they require their own optimization process.

# **🚀 The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82145&key=user_uploads/501039/b7c1f4c7-b654-40e6-9e1d-84ab93f4ad5f)

The best [LLM evals](https://joschkabraun.com) are adapted to your particular business use case & data. We've developed a method for uploading human annotations (via CSV or using our [Annotation Queue](https://docs.parea.ai/manual-review/queue)) and bootstrapping an evaluation to mimic the annotations. To create a human-aligned eval, you need as few as 20 sample annotations. Using your new LLM eval is as easy as copying the code into your codebase or using it directly via Parea's API. Check out [our docs](https://docs.parea.ai/manual-review/bootstrapped-eval) to see the complete workflow.

launches.tagline: Global and EU compliant outreach. Run targeted email, LinkedIn and letter campaigns.
launches.body:
Hey YC!

We are Lucas and Stefan from Venta AI. A year ago we launched an outreach tool for Europe and soon had to learn about EU-compliance laws. Since cold mailing is not legal in most of Europe, we implemented LinkedIn and letters as alternative and highly effective outreach channels. Today we are launching Venta AI 2.0 -compliant AI SDR that can run multi-channel outreach campaigns to highly targeted prospects globally.

**TL;DR:** Venta AI is a legally compliant AI SDR that automates prospecting and cold outreach via letters, LinkedIn and email. Thanks to our AI-based qualification and multi-channel approach you can reach every customer, avoid landing in SPAM and increase your reply rates at least 2x.

[**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0BjDrlGZCb0**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0BjDrlGZCb0\*\*)

**Meet Europe’s strict regulations on cold outreach**

When we started cold outreach, compliance wasn’t top of mind. We knew that many EU countries have restrictions and informed our users about them. But soon enough one user received a cease and desist letter for sending a cold email and had to pay a hefty fine. This incident prompted us to take a closer look. EU regulations generally forbid sending electronic messages without an explicit opt-in. In many cases, enforcement might be lax, but if you run afoul of these laws, you could face everything from a cease and desist letter (with fines in the hundreds) to a lawsuit (potential fines of up to hundreds of thousands) or even a severe GDPR violation, which can result in penalties reaching millions.

If you think this is solely a European issue, you might also want to check out Canada’s anti-spam legislation (CASL) or Australia’s Spam Act.

**Email deliverability is a nightmare**

The second problem everyone faces with cold mailing is email deliverability. People have written enough about this on Bookface, so I will just say: it becomes a never ending cat and mouse game between cold mailers and email service providers (mainly Gmail and especially Outlook).

**Compliant ways to reach out**

If you don't want to break any laws in the above countries, you have 3 options for cold outreach:

* LinkedIn messages (allowed if connection request accepted)
* Phone calls (allowed with "presumed consent")
* Sending letters (always allowed)

Since LinkedIn limits how much you can send and phone calls take a lot of time, there is only one truly compliant and infinitely scalable way to cold outreach: letters.

**Launching Venta AI 2.0 - compliant outreach at scale**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88760&key=user_uploads/1367242/8ae24024-3a29-4a24-8ab4-2cfefb753cc7)

Today we are launching Venta AI 2.0, which allows you to run multi-channel outreach via email, LinkedIn and letters, while remaining compliant in each country.

Since letters need to be printed and postage paid, we help you use this channel as cost-efficiently and effectively as possible:

1. **Qualification**: Venta AI qualifies accounts based on your own questions, such as: "Is this a logistics company that uses electric trucks". This helps to ensure that you are only contacting your ICPs.
2. **Contact Picking**: Letters should only be sent to 1-2 people in a company. Venta AI always selects the most appropriate contact from all employees in a company based on your buying personas.
3. **The correct postal address:** As described [here](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/posts/86152), we have learned the hard way that many business addresses in company databases are just plain wrong. So we scrape the addresses directly from a company's website, select the location closest to our prospect and validate the address before sending.
4. **CTAs & Traceability:** Letters work differently than emails. To bridge the gap from analog to digital, we always include personalized QR codes on every letter. You get an instant Slack notification with the contact's number when they scan it.
5. **Saving money on sending**: You can send worldwide directly from our platform and simply pay with credits in your subscription.

**What to expect from letters**

We ran several campaigns testing letters directly against email, sending the same message to the same ICP (CEOs in marketing agencies). Email campaigns were run with fully warmed up Gmail accounts, optimized sending times and AI spintax. Letter campaigns were printed with a handwritten font.

On average across 1200 contacts we saw a **2x improvement** in reply rate (4.5% from letters vs. 2.5% from emails) and meeting booked rate (1.5% vs. 0.6%).

# **Let’s get physical**

Want to try letters as an additional or compliant way of reaching customers?

Let’s talk. Contact us at [lucas@getventa.ai](https://mailto:lucas@getventa.ai) or book a demo at <https://www.getventa.ai/trial>
